scope: Partial review of root repository instructions for cleanup of references to removed GitHub workflows. Agent skills, external user instructions and historical notes were not classified as project-wide constraints. Birdify found GEMINI.md pointing to the removed .github/copilot-instructions.md; that gap is included in the cleanup plan.

rules.name: Report changed files and checks
rules.anchor: - Before handoff, run relevant quality checks and report changed files and validation results.
rules.explanation: State the files changed and checks actually run. A missing or blocked check must remain explicit.
rules.verification: Inspect the final diff and report command results without claiming unrun checks passed.

rules.name: Preserve Git state unless authorized
rules.anchor: - Do not create branches, commit, push, merge, or sync IssueGraph remotes unless the user explicitly asks. When asked for a PR, target `main`.
rules.condition: When cleanup touches repository history or remote state
rules.explanation: Documentation cleanup does not authorize branch, commit, push, merge or tracker-sync operations.
rules.verification: Check Git status and ensure cleanup does not change repository history or remote state.
